title: 1 & 2 Corinthians in 15 Weeks
description: A 15-week reading plan covering every chapter of both epistles, two chapters a week. Readings open on Bible Gateway (NKJV); each week links to the question-seed form.

weeks.summary: Crosses, wisdom, and the mind of Christ.
God's building, stewards of the mysteries.
Church discipline and lawsuits among believers.
Marriage, singleness, and food offered to idols.
Ministry rights, Christian freedom, and Israel's warnings.
Worship order, headship, and gifts for the body.
Love's priority and the proper use of tongues and prophecy.
Resurrection hope and final practical church instructions.
Comfort in affliction; the God of all comfort.
A new-covenant ministry that unveils the Lord's light.
Earthly tents, eternal home, and reconciliation in service.
Sorrow that leads to repentance and generous giving.
Cheerful generosity and apostolic authority over opposition.
False apostles exposed; strength in weakness and visions.
Church discipline, examination, and final apostolic appeal.
